subject: Umbrella Tech procurement intake — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodInference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@umbrellatech.com>
Cc: procure@umbrellatech.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake + security docs needed to progress (Umbrella Tech)

Hi Sofia —

Great to connect on the call last week. We're excited to move Umbrella Tech through our procurement intake so we can get you live on Redwood Dedicated. To keep the onboarding on track, procurement has a short checklist we need completed before we can issue a PO and finalize terms: 

- Signed DPA (we prefer DocuSign)
- Current SOC 2 report or an access link to the report
- Full subprocessor inventory (names + purpose + location)
- Billing contact and PO routing instructions
- Completed vendor intake form (attached)

I've attached our Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf — if you can return that plus the DPA and subprocessors this week, procurement can queue a PO. Do you have an internal procurement contact I should loop in, or should we send the DPA to procure@umbrellatech.com?

Also please flag any clauses in the DPA your legal team needs added so we can route redlines early — our standard retention clause typically needs a short confirmation for regulated data.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — appreciate the clear list. Attaching the DPA draft (Umbrella_DPA_v1.docx) and our current subprocessor export (umbrella_subprocessors.csv). Our SOC 2 report is available here: https://security.umbrellatech.com/soc2-report-2025.pdf — it's the latest compact report (Type II).

Quick notes:
- We can sign via DocuSign. I initiated a DocuSign envelope this morning; link below once it's populated on our side.
- For PO processing, please have the PO sent to billing@umbrellatech.com and include Reference: Company Name + Redwood deal id in the PO text — that helps our AR team tag invoices.
- Our procurement contact is Jorge Alvarez (jorge.alvarez@umbrellatech.com) — he will confirm payment terms and treasury instructions.

I'll flag the DPA to legal for a quick review; if there are specific redlines you expect from Redwood, send them over to me and I can pre-clear with Jorge.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez

- Laura: can you review Umbrella_DPA_v1.docx for the typical retention clause and any show-stopper redlines? They mentioned we can sign via DocuSign. If we need to propose an alternate retention period or carveouts, let me know the exact language we should request.

- Marcus: they asked that POs be sent to billing@umbrellatech.com and include the reference line with the deal id. Is that acceptable for our AR processes? Also confirm the timeline for issuing a PO once legal signs off (we usually need 3 business days after procurement approval).

Sofia — looping Jorge is fine; Laura will coordinate any DPA redlines.

Ben

Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia@umbrellatech.com>, Jorge Alvarez <jorge.alvarez@umbrellatech.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor intake + security docs needed to progress (Umbrella Tech)

Ben / Marcus / Sofia / Jorge —

Thanks for sending over the packet and the SOC 2 link. Procurement reviewed Umbrella_DPA_v1.docx and the subprocessor inventory. Below are the actions we need to close before we can raise a PO: 

1) DPA redline: Redwood requires a data retention clause amendment clarifying that Redwood will instruct deletion of customer data within 45 days of contract termination for production data; Umbrella's draft lists 90 days. We are willing to accept 60 days as a negotiation baseline. Please confirm if Umbrella can accept 60 days or provide business reason for 90.

2) Subprocessor attestations: Umbrella's csv is a good start, but procurement asks for attestations (point-in-time confirmation) for any subprocessor processing Redwood customer data. We accept a secure-portal attestation export or signed letter. If you have a portal, please provide the export link or upload a signed attestation to your vendor portal.

3) PO routing: Marcus — Redwood will issue a PO to billing@umbrellatech.com referencing RDW-2026-UT-0421. Please confirm internal cost center and approval chain so we can include the PO number on the DocuSign envelope. Our typical timing is: procurement sign-off (this ticket) -> PO generated within 2 business days -> vendor acceptance -> go-live scheduling.

4) Attachments & links: Sofia, please either populate the DocuSign envelope with the final DPA or confirm you want Redwood to upload our standard DPA for redline. Also, please attach a copy of the signed subprocessor attestations (PDF) if available.

I've attached PO_Instructions.pdf (procurement checklist + invoice format) and a sample PO template for your AR team.

If Umbrella can confirm the 60-day retention or a justification for 90, procurement can clear this and we'll issue the PO.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: PO_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
Related link (portal for attestations): https://vendors.redwoodinference.com/attestations/upload
